component.name: CatchGame
component.script:
sub init() m.W = LumenTheme().gameW m.H = LumenTheme().gameH m.bw = 140 m.bh = 70 m.by = m.H - m.bh - 14
kitInit("catch") m.sky = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.sky.width = m.W m.sky.height = m.W * 9 / 16 m.sky.translation = [0, -150] m.scrim = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.scrim.width = m.W m.scrim.height = m.H kitStripAnim(m.top, "pkg:/images/games/hills_night.png", 1400, 80, m.H - 72, 24)
' Pool of falling items; each slot holds a star and a drop and shows one of them. m.items = m.top.createChild("Group") m.pool = [] for i = 0 to 11 g = m.items.createChild("Group") star = g.createChild("Poster") star.uri = "pkg:/images/games/star.png" star.width = 52 star.height = 52 ink = g.createChild("Poster") ink.uri = "pkg:/images/games/drop.png" ink.width = 38 ink.height = 46 g.visible = false m.pool.Push({ g: g, star: star, ink: ink, x: 0.0, y: 0.0, drop: false, w: 0, h: 0, used: false }) end for
m.basket = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.basket.uri = "pkg:/images/games/basket.png" m.basket.width = m.bw m.basket.height = m.bh
m.lifeIcons = [] for i = 0 to 2 p = m.top.createChild("Poster") p.uri = "pkg:/images/games/star.png" p.width = 34 p.height = 34 p.translation = [18 + i * 40, 16] m.lifeIcons.Push(p) end for reset() end sub
sub onTheme() m.sky.uri = "pkg:/images/wall/wall_" + m.top.theme + ".jpg" end sub
sub onDeep() m.scrim.color = WithAlpha(m.top.deep, 0.25) end sub
sub reset() for each it in m.pool it.used = false it.g.visible = false end for m.bx = (m.W - m.bw) / 2 m.dir = 0 m.lives = 3 m.spawnT = 0.5 m.interval = 0.9 m.fall = 150 m.basket.translation = [m.bx, m.by] for each p in m.lifeIcons p.opacity = 1 end for end sub
sub begin() end sub
sub action(k as string) if k = "left" m.dir = -1 else if k = "right" m.dir = 1 else if k = "left_up" and m.dir = -1 m.dir = 0 else if k = "right_up" and m.dir = 1 m.dir = 0 end if end sub
sub spawn() for each it in m.pool if not it.used it.used = true it.drop = Rnd(100) <= 22 + m.top.points / 2 it.star.visible = not it.drop it.ink.visible = it.drop if it.drop it.w = 38 it.h = 46 else it.w = 52 it.h = 52 end if it.x = 20 + Rnd(m.W - 80) it.y = -60.0 it.g.translation = [it.x, it.y] it.g.visible = true return end if end for end sub
sub loseLife() m.lives = m.lives - 1 if m.lives >= 0 and m.lives < 3 then m.lifeIcons[m.lives].opacity = 0.2 if m.lives <= 0 then kitOver() end sub
sub advance(dt as float) m.bx = m.bx + m.dir * 640 * dt if m.bx < 0 then m.bx = 0 if m.bx > m.W - m.bw then m.bx = m.W - m.bw m.basket.translation = [m.bx, m.by]
m.spawnT = m.spawnT - dt if m.spawnT <= 0 spawn() m.spawnT = m.interval if m.interval > 0.36 then m.interval = m.interval - 0.015 if m.fall < 360 then m.fall = m.fall + 3 end if
for each it in m.pool if it.used and m.top.state = "play" it.y = it.y + m.fall * dt it.g.translation = [it.x, it.y] cx = it.x + it.w / 2 if it.y + it.h >= m.by + 12 and it.y < m.by + 34 and cx > m.bx + 12 and cx < m.bx + m.bw - 12 it.used = false it.g.visible = false if it.drop then loseLife() else m.top.points = m.top.points + 1 else if it.y > m.H it.used = false it.g.visible = false if not it.drop then loseLife() end if end if end for end sub
